name: doc-discovery
description: Discover documentation staleness, map codebase changes to UI routes, and suggest CSS selectors.

actions.name: check documentation staleness
actions.description: Analyzes the Git history to find Markdown files that are behind the latest code changes. (Triggers: 'which docs are stale?', 'check documentation status')

actions.name: resolve ui route
actions.description: Maps a file path to its corresponding URL in the running application. (Trigger: 'what is the route for this file?')

actions.name: suggest selectors
actions.description: Scans a UI component file to suggest CSS selectors and a component name. (Trigger: 'suggest selectors for this component')
